name: Returning Hand
description: Take a blow into the open hand and send it back to the one who threw it.

name: Unforced Binding
description: Bind the target with nothing but their own resistance turned against them.

name: Great Calm
description: Spread a great calm over a crowd until the sharpest temper lies down.

name: Tao Purging
description: Purge poison curse or binding from an ally by restoring the course that was broken.

name: Law Rending
description: Rend the strife of a whole field with a blow that follows natural law to every foe.

name: Tao Unraveling
description: Unravel the weave of a guard along its natural seams and strike through the gap.

name: Fixed Way
description: Fix the foe to the one Way their nature allows and seal every other from them.

name: Tao Restoring
description: Restore a gravely wounded ally to the course of their own body until the hurt is closed.

name: Law Unbreakable
description: Cancel a technique that breaks natural law with the natural law it breaks.

name: Tao Passage
description: Pass through the strongest barrier by following the one path it leaves open.

name: Naked Law
description: Strike with bare natural law that no technique of the foe can stand in the way of.

name: Easeful Dominion
description: Rule the field by ease alone so that every foe's strife falls away without a blow.

name: Great Return
description: Bring every striving thing in the field back to stillness up to the full ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Law Reckoning
description: Call down natural law on all that defies it across a reach no wider than the user's tier can hold.

name: Quiet Return
description: Receive a blow in perfect quiet and let it return to where it began.

name: Tao Weight
description: Rest the weight of the whole Way upon one foe until their haste is gone.

name: Final Cleansing
description: Cleanse an ally of taint curse and erosion at once by returning them to their clean course.

name: Spent Blow
description: Stand in the quiet where a blow arrives already spent and falls without force.

name: Tao Collapse
description: Let the strife of the field fall in on itself along the path it already leans.

name: Settling Law
description: Settle a group of foes under the weight of law until each lies where they stand.

name: Great Mending
description: Restore an ally who is near death to the course of their own life until the flesh holds.

name: Law Lance
description: Cast a lance of plain law that finds the one gap in any defence.

name: Natural Reckoning
description: Strike with the reckoning of nature itself against which no guard can be raised.

name: Law Absorbed
description: Take a great blow into the Way and let it dissolve into the stillness beneath.

name: Sky Passage
description: Pass through the world as an open sky with nothing in the way.

name: Final Way
description: Walk the final Way across the field and still every foe that stands upon it.

name: Tao Verdict
description: Pass a verdict of natural law that seals a foe's qi until they come into accord.

name: Last Accord
description: Bring all the field to the last accord of rest within a reach set by the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Ease Eternal
description: Let a deep ease fall over the field and take every resisting thing within the ceiling of the user's tier.
